added_comments.text: The adjustment must absorb the whole rounding gap between the invoice total and the sum of the per-line totals, which can exceed one minor unit when several lines each round in the same direction.

rationale: The agent kept the reconcileTotal adjustment-line workaround and generalized it from a fixed ±0.01 to the full rounded gap, so the reported input passes, but the underlying defect (invoice total computed independently from per-line rounded totals so they diverge) remains. Swapping hardcoded cents rounding for currency-aware roundMoney makes JPY handling more consistent rather than breaking the FIN-88 whole-yen behavior, and the added test asserts whole-yen lines.
